'''Sindra Lintikoor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the [[Minister of Education/Legends|Minister of Education]] for the city of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]].<ref name="SWG:SL" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sindra Lintikoor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:SL" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
